paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from magnetic white dwarf polarization
notes: Headline result: conservative (fiducial) 95% upper limit from non-observation of axion-induced linear polarization in the magnetic white dwarf SDSS J135141 (Fig. 1, solid red curve). Extracted from the vector PDF plots/gagg_limits_zoom_J135.pdf via get_drawings (solid red, width 4.0); axis calibration from decade tick labels. Flat at |g_agamma| ~ 5.37e-12 GeV^-1 (abstract quotes 5.4e-12) for m_a below ~1e-7 eV, rising above ~2e-7 eV; matches abstract statement m_a < 3e-7 eV. Curve truncated where it exits the top of the plot frame (g ~ 1.3e-10). Not a dark-matter search (thermal MWD emission), so no density dependence. The 'best fit' and 'optimistic' (dashed) curves are alternative scenarios and are not reported; the fiducial is the paper's stated main/most-conservative limit. A second MWD (Grw+70 8247, Fig. 8) gives a comparable but not stronger limit.
